dedupe_keys.name: provincia sondrio centri abitati da codice della strada

description: PROVINCIA SONDRIO - CENTRI ABITATI DA CODICE DELLA STRADA is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by provinciasondrio.it. A detailed representation of the residential centres in the province of Sondrio in accordance with Legislative Decree No 285 of 30 April 1992 – New Highway Code, accompanied by an information sheet in consultation containing the approval decision of the municipal council and the minutes signed between the municipality and the province. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "PROVINCE SONDRIO - ROAD CODE CENTRES" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include codice della strada, strade, viabilita, provincia di sondrio, pianificazione, reti per la mobilità. The listing shows 2024-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
